description: A bare 'und' catalog beside an ordinary one. und's own likely subtag IS populated (CLDR maximizes und to en-Latn), but SupportedLocaleStatics nulls it out for undetermined locales before the likely-subtag comparison at DefaultStrings:2071. The two catalogs are deliberately in unrelated languages so that nothing else can claim an English request: if a port compares the raw likely subtag instead of the undetermined-suppressed one, und wins an en request outright.
